        local end=$2
        local chunk_primes=0

            if [ $i -lt 2 ]; then continue; fi
            
            is_prime=1
            if [ $i -eq 2 ]; then

                continue

            fi
        done

        start=$((core * chunk_size + 2))

        if [ $core -eq $((NUM_CORES-1)) ]; then
            end=$total_range
        else
            end=$((start + chunk_size))
        fi

        find_primes_in_range $start $end &
        pids+="$! "

        total_primes=$((total_primes + result))
    done
    
    echo "✅ Prime benchmark completed: Found $total_primes primes across $NUM_CORES cores"
}

    echo "🔧 Running high-iteration matrix multiplication benchmark (20 iterations)..."
    
    # Function to create and multiply matrices
    multiply_matrices() {
        local size=$1
        
        # Initialize matrices with random values
        declare -A matrix1
        declare -A matrix2
        declare -A result
        
        for ((i=0; i<size; i++)); do
            for ((j=0; j<size; j++)); do
                matrix1[$i,$j]=$((RANDOM % 100))
                matrix2[$i,$j]=$((RANDOM % 100))
                result[$i,$j]=0
            done
        done
        
        # Multiply matrices
        for ((i=0; i<size; i++)); do
            for ((j=0; j<size; j++)); do
                for ((k=0; k<size; k++)); do
                    result[$i,$j]=$((result[$i,$j] + matrix1[$i,$k] * matrix2[$k,$j]))
                done
            done
        done
        
        # Return a checksum of the result
        local checksum=0
        for ((i=0; i<size; i++)); do
            for ((j=0; j<size; j++)); do
                checksum=$(((checksum + result[$i,$j]) % 1000000))
            done
        done
        
        echo $checksum
    }
    
    start_matrix=$(date +%s)
    total_time=0
    
    for i in {1..20}; do
        iteration_start=$(date +%s)
        checksum=$(multiply_matrices 100)
        iteration_end=$(date +%s)
        iteration_time=$((iteration_end - iteration_start))
        total_time=$((total_time + iteration_time))
        echo "Iteration $i completed in $iteration_time seconds - Checksum: $checksum"
    done
    
    avg_time=$((total_time / 20))
    echo "✅ Matrix benchmark completed: 20 iterations, average time $avg_time seconds"
}

# Compression benchmark (CPU intensive)
compression_benchmark() {
    echo "🔧 Running high-iteration compression benchmark (30 iterations)..."
    
    # Create a test file for compression
    TEST_FILE="/tmp/compression_test.dat"
    if [ ! -f "$TEST_FILE" ]; then
        echo "Creating test file..."
        dd if=/dev/urandom of="$TEST_FILE" bs=1M count=10 2>/dev/null
    fi
    
    start_comp=$(date +%s)
    total_time=0
    
    for i in {1..30}; do
        iteration_start=$(date +%s)
        # Use gzip with maximum compression
        gzip -c9 "$TEST_FILE" > "/tmp/compressed.gz" 2>/dev/null
        gunzip -c "/tmp/compressed.gz" > "/tmp/decompressed.dat" 2>/dev/null
        iteration_end=$(date +%s)
        iteration_time=$((iteration_end - iteration_start))
        total_time=$((total_time + iteration_time))
        echo "Iteration $i completed in $iteration_time seconds"
    done
    
    # Cleanup
    rm -f "/tmp/compressed.gz" "/tmp/decompressed.dat"
    
    avg_time=$((total_time / 30))
    echo "✅ Compression benchmark completed: 30 iterations, average time $avg_time seconds"
}

# Multi-core stress test
multi_core_stress() {
    echo "🔧 Running multi-core stress test with $NUM_CORES parallel processes..."
    
    # Function for CPU-intensive work
    cpu_intensive_task() {
        local iterations=50000000
        local result=0
        
        for ((i=1; i<=iterations; i++)); do
            # Complex calculation to keep CPU busy
            result=$(( (result + i * i) % 1000000 ))
        done
        
        echo $result
    }
    
    start_stress=$(date +%s)
    pids=""
    
    # Launch a CPU-intensive process for each core
    for ((core=0; core<NUM_CORES; core++)); do
        cpu_intensive_task &
        pids+="$! "
    done
    
    # Wait for all processes
    for pid in $pids; do
        wait $pid
    done
    
    end_stress=$(date +%s)
    stress_time=$((end_stress - start_stress))
    echo "✅ Multi-core stress test completed in $stress_time seconds"
}
